content: react-markdown v10.1.0 (current npm) is ESM-only, renders Markdown to React elements safely (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML) via remark/rehype under the hood. Accepts a 'components' prop mapping tag names (h1-h6, p, a, img, ul, li, strong, em, etc.) to custom React components/render functions, and a 'remarkPlugins' array (e.g. remark-gfm v4.0.1 for GFM tables/strikethrough/task lists). Example: <Markdown components={{ img: CustomImage }} remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}>{markdownString}</Markdown>.
